text.value:
SELECT CAST((CASE WHEN DATEPART(weekday,[LastQtrEnd]) = 1 THEN DATEADD(DD, -2, [LastQtrEnd])
		WHEN DATEPART(weekday,[LastQtrEnd]) = 7 THEN DATEADD(DD, -1, [LastQtrEnd])
		ELSE [LastQtrEnd] END) AS DATE) AS 'LastQtrBusEnd'
  FROM [Utility].[dbo].[Calendar]
  WHERE CurrentDate = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
  ORDER BY CurrentDate DESC

UPDATE ReconControl.dbo.tbl_SLACP_text_blocks
SET eff_date = (SELECT TOP 1 CAST((CASE WHEN DATEPART(weekday,[LastQtrEnd]) = 1 THEN DATEADD(DD, -2, [LastQtrEnd])
		WHEN DATEPART(weekday,[LastQtrEnd]) = 7 THEN DATEADD(DD, -1, [LastQtrEnd])
		ELSE [LastQtrEnd] END) AS DATE) AS 'LastQtrBusEnd'
  FROM [Utility].[dbo].[Calendar]
  WHERE CurrentDate = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
  ORDER BY CurrentDate DESC)

UPDATE b
SET b.legalFullName = a.legalFullName
FROM tbl_CID_Data a
     INNER JOIN tbl_SLACP_CID_Data b
     ON a.legalIdC = b.legalIdC
WHERE a.busAExtlSystemC IN ('LOANET', 'G1')
     AND a.busAExtlStatC NOT IN ('CLOSED')

UPDATE a
SET a.line1 = b.legalFullName
FROM ReconControl.dbo.tbl_SLACP_auditcrfm_data a
     LEFT JOIN ReconControl.dbo.tbl_SLACP_CID_Data b
     ON a.contraParty = b.busAExtlKeyCLegal
WHERE a.line1 IS NULL OR a.line1= '';

UPDATE a
SET a.longDesc = b.longDesc
FROM ReconControl.dbo.tbl_SLACP_auditcrfm_data a
     LEFT JOIN ReconControl.dbo.tbl_SLACP_product_detail b
     ON a.cusip = b.cusip
WHERE a.longDesc IS NULL OR a.longDesc = '';

UPDATE a
SET a.longDesc = b.[InstrumentDescription1]
FROM ReconControl.dbo.tbl_SLACP_auditcrfm_data a
     LEFT JOIN ReconControl.dbo.tbl_SLACP_FACS_Instrument b
     ON a.cusip = b.cusip
WHERE a.longDesc IS NULL OR a.longDesc = '';

auditcrfm_Loanet_Position.defaultValue:
SELECT DISTINCT clientId, contraParty, cusip, quantity, contractAmount, contractNumber, deliveryDate, effDate, borrowLoan, 'Loanet' AS 'origin'
FROM dbo.Loanet_Position
WHERE effDate  =  '3/31/2026'
AND DateDiff(day,[deliveryDate],[effDate]) >= 30 AND contraParty NOT IN ('2480', 'SUSP', '0250')

auditcrfm_GlobalOne_Position.defaultValue:
SELECT DISTINCT ClientID, CPTY, CASE WHEN CUSIP IS NULL OR CUSIP = '' THEN 'ISIN ' + CASE WHEN [ISIN] IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE [ISIN] END ELSE CUSIP END AS CUSIP, QTY, LNVAL, BGNREF, SSET_DT, EFFDATE, BL, 'GlobalOne' AS 'origin'
FROM dbo.GlobalOne_PF_Position
WHERE EFFDATE  =  '3/31/2026'
AND DateDiff(day,[SSET_DT],[EFFDATE]) >= 30
AND CPTY NOT IN ('2480', 'SUSP', '0250')
